title: Willingness-to-pay space and preference space: a unified treatment of equivalence, heterogeneity and interpretation
abstract: arXiv:2611.07698v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A growing number of choice modelling studies estimate their models "in willingness-to-pay (WTP) space", yet often treat this as a different model that fits better (or worse) than "preference space", and misread what its parameters represent. This note brings together and makes precise insights that have mostly been stated only in scattered places, organising them around a single condition for two specifications to be the same model. WTP space is a reparameterisation, and with non-random coefficients the two spaces give identical likelihoods, WTP estimates and standard errors. With deterministic heterogeneity in cost sensitivity, or non-linearity, WTP must still be computed as a ratio of partial derivatives, although a simple normalisation recovers a directly estimated WTP at a reference point. translated_title: 支付意愿空间与偏好空间：对等价性、异质性与解释的统一处理
translated_abstract: 越来越多的选择建模研究在“支付意愿（WTP）空间”中估计模型，但往往将其视为一个与“偏好空间”不同的、拟合更好（或更差）的模型，并误读其参数所代表的含义。本说明汇集并精确化了那些大多只在零散之处被提及的见解，将其围绕于一个单一条件来组织——该条件决定了两种设定何时是同一个模型。WTP空间本质上是一种重新参数化，在系数非随机的情况下，两个空间给出完全相同的似然值、WTP估计值和标准误。当成本敏感性存在确定性异质性或非线性时，WTP仍必须作为偏导数之比来计算，不过通过一个简单的标准化，可以在某一参考点处恢复直接估计的WTP。在随机异质性的情况下，潜类别模型在两个空间中是完全等价的，而其他混合模型仅在隐含的分布（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 本文统一澄清了支付意愿空间与偏好空间的关系——WTP空间仅是偏好空间的重新参数化，在非随机系数下两者完全等价，并精确界定了在确定性与随机异质性及非线性情形下两空间等价的条件与参数的正确解释。
en_tdlr: This note unifies and clarifies that WTP space is merely a reparameterisation of preference space—yielding identical likelihoods, WTP estimates and standard errors with non-random coefficients—while precisely establishing the conditions for equivalence and the correct interpretation of parameters under deterministic and random heterogeneity and non-linearity.
